FULL TEXT:
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
Panjab University, Chandigarh
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Senior Research Fellow
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Senior Research Fellow in a
DST SERB research project entitled “Development and evaluation of fish oil-probiotic
supplement composite dressing for chronic wounds”.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the undersigned or
sent by post latest by Monday, 9th January 2023 by 10:00 a.m.
Eligible candidates may appear for a Walk-in interview on Tuesday, 10th January 2023, 2:30
p.m. in the office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh. No separate interview
letters will be issued. The tenure of the post is co-terminus with the project i.e. July, 2023.
Fellowship: Monthly emoluments are @ 35,000/- p.m.
Essential Qualification: 1. M.Pharm. /M. Tech/Ph.D with minimum 55% marks (50% in case of
SC/ST/PH)
2. GATE/GPAT/NET qualified
Eligible candidates are requested to bring original testimonials at the time of interview.
Sd/-
Dr Indu Pal Kaur
Professor of Pharmaceutics &
Chairperson UIPS
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
Panjab University, Sector 14
Chandigarh, 160014
Email id: indupalkaur@pu.ac.in, profindupalkaur@gmail.com
